title: ‘Vibe coding’ makes the dictionary: AI terms recognized by Merriam-Webster
title_zh: “Vibe 编码”让词典更新：Merriam-Webster 认可的 AI 术语
abstract: ‘Agentic’, ‘prompt engineering’ and other technical terms are among the 1,400 entries added to the online catalogue of the iconic lexicon.
abstract_zh: “Agentic”（主导性）、“prompt engineering”（提示工程）等技术术语已被纳入标志性词典的在线目录，共计 1,400 条新词条。
